lines.t1: A sprint is a fixed timebox of one month or less.
lines.t2: Each sprint ends with a usable increment of the product.
lines.f1: Short cycles bring feedback in weeks, not months.
lines.f2: Small batches mean smaller mistakes and less risk.
lines.g1: During a sprint the goal stays fixed, so the team can focus without constant change.
lines.g2: New ideas are not lost. They wait in the backlog for a later sprint.
